mapper.select: select st.id, st.status, st.completed_on, st.teacher_note, g.title, g.description, g.module, g.due_on, g.point_reward from student_task st join growth_task g on g.id = st.task_id where st.student_id = #{studentId} and g.status = 'PUBLISHED' order by g.due_on, st.id
select st.id, st.status from student_task st join growth_task g on g.id = st.task_id where st.id = #{studentTaskId} and st.student_id = #{studentId} and g.status = 'PUBLISHED' for update
select id, content, status, feedback, created_at, reviewed_at from task_submission where student_task_id = #{studentTaskId} order by id desc
select id, content, status, feedback, created_at, reviewed_at from task_submission where student_task_id = #{studentTaskId} order by id desc limit 1
select max(id) from task_submission where student_task_id = #{studentTaskId}
mapper.insert: insert into task_submission(student_task_id, request_key, content) values (#{studentTaskId}, #{requestKey}, #{content})
mapper.update: update student_task set status = 'SUBMITTED' where id = #{studentTaskId}
update student_task set status = 'RETURNED', teacher_note = #{note} where id = #{studentTaskId}
